job.name: yulia_astro_b
job.meaning: Юля, пышные волосы, кремовый мягкий свитер, светлая комната днём, на столе карта звёздного неба и чашка чая. Причёска (пышнее) и одежда/обстановка изменены НАМЕРЕННО — по референсу совпадать должно только лицо.
job.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo of exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, same blue-grey eyes, same freckles, same nose, lips and face shape — she must be clearly recognisable as the same real person), looking fresh, rested and radiant: healthy glowing skin with natural freckles kept, soft natural make-up (light mascara, groomed brows, nude-rose lips), her long brown hair made noticeably FULLER and more voluminous — soft glossy waves with lift at the roots, healthy shine, warm chestnut tones. FRAMING: medium shot from the waist up, she SITS at a small round table facing the camera, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, hands resting calmly on the table, face large and sharp, top of head about 10% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, calm warm knowing expression, lips slightly parted as if about to speak, NO broad smile. Look: a real high-end phone photo for a lifestyle blog, bright and vivid but natural colours, true-to-life skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT plastic retouch, NOT a different person. No text, no logos, no watermark. Outfit: a soft cream knit sweater, small gold earrings. Setting: a bright airy room in daylight by a big window, sheer curtains and green plants softly blurred; on the table an old celestial star-chart print (only drawings of constellations, no readable text), a cup of tea and a few tarot cards face down. Fresh, light, uplifting mood.
job.person_note: The face must be exactly the woman from the attached photo; hairstyle volume, outfit and setting are intentionally changed.
